  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 942 4434 9028
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/94244349028

  PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56237  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, July 23, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56238  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Dr. Iliana Perez of
  Immigrants Rising on the impacts of recent federal immigration enforcement on
  women and families.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56239  Recommendation to discuss and identify objectives for the Commission for Women
  and Girls 2025 Vision Mapping Session (Retreat).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
